name: agentguard
description: Client for AgentGuard, the commercial governance service by Krynex Labs: asks it before every shell command, file write and web fetch. Shadow mode records; enforce mode carries out deny and ask and asks a person when the service cannot answer. Requires an AgentGuard instance and key.

url.title: AgentGuard address
url.description: Base URL of your AgentGuard service, for example http://127.0.0.1:18095. Loopback or private network only: tool calls carry commands and file contents.

key.title: AgentGuard key
key.description: The agent key from the AgentGuard console (agk_…). Stored in the system's secure credential store.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow: record only, nothing is stopped. enforce: deny and ask are carried out.

agent_id.title: Agent id
agent_id.description: The agent the key is bound to.
